newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse offers services in broker offices.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse offers services in broker offices.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) will introduce on Wednesday its new system allowing floor traders to trade on screens from their offices instead of going to the bourse, the BSE said in a statement on Tuesday.
"As of October 9, bourse members will be able to do spot business from their offices," it said.

"This development was the result of the BSE's aim to become a leading, developed bourse of the region, as well as of the expected expansion in number of bourse members and of the potential increase of trading time," it said.
Bourse members participating in this system will continue to have trading boxes on the floor, it said.
In the first phase 14 bourse members, representing 65.23 percent of total BSE turnover in 1995, have bought the new service.

The 14 are AB-Moneta, Creditanstalt Securities, Concorde Securities, CS First Boston Budapest, Daiwa-MKB, Hypo-Securities Hungaria, ING Barings, Inter-Europa Investment, National Bank of Hungary, New York Broker Budapest, OTP Broker, Postabank Securities, Takarek Broker Securities and WestLB Investment.
